basics.name: João Francisco Domingues de Moura e Silva
basics.label: Electrical engineering student
basics.summary: Graduate student of electrical engineering at USP, campus of São Carlos. Currently working in my end of course project about voltage stability analysis in electrical networks with high presence of photovoltaic generation. And working as quality intern at Wabtec Corporation, in Araraquara-SP, Brazil.

work.name: Wabtec Corporation (locomotive manufacturer)
highlights: Development of process improvement projects in the storage and locomotive maintenance workshop. Implementation of 5S and Lean Manufacturing concepts in these projects.

Emission of non conformity reports of parts and systems of the locomotives. Work with technical drawings and compartison with physical materials. Analysis of tendencies of the non-conformities and elaboration of action plans to eliminate future problems.
Automation of administrative and data analysis processes related to the Quality sector using Microsoft tools such as PowerAutomate, PowerBI and Python programming.

work.name: Department of electrical and computer engineering - SEL (EESC-USP)
highlights: Development of project and descriptive documents for the photovoltaic installations in the São Carlos campus of the University of São Paulo (USP). Photovoltaic modules, inverters, systems of measurement and protection.
Use of AUTOCAD to create 2D diagrams and one-line diagrams. Knowledge of technical norms such as ABNT and ANEEL. Use of PVSyst software to design the PV systems.
Cost analysis, maintenance and update of documents, organization of technical visits and other administrative activites for the USP Energy Transition Work Group.

work.name: Ambar Tech (civil engineering firm)
highlights: Develppment of budgets, cost analysis of projects, use of Revit and AUTOCAD for visualization of received projects, comparison of traditional and the company's construction methods.

Data analysis and creation of dashboards to inform on the warehouse, purchases, sales, production, payment of salaries and benefits. Using tools such as RP TOTVS Protheus, Salesforce, Excel, Google Sheets, PostgreSQL, Power BI, LookerStudio.
Participation in process improvement projects in the areas of warehouse, purchases, production. Creation of cronograms and tools for the application of these improvements.
